display_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-07-D3-11 Demonstration of hydropower technologies for efficient and forward-looking refurbishment of existing hydropower plants – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-07-D3-11 Demonstration of hydropower technologies for efficient and forward-looking refurbishment of existing hydropower plants
executive_summary: Demonstrates ways to refurbish existing hydropower plants and improve flexible output, fleet controls, grid integration and climate resilience. Eligible consortium beneficiaries can receive up to 70% for for-profit beneficiaries under Horizon Europe. The indicative topic budget is EUR 17 million, with around EUR 8.5 million expected per project. Opening 2027-08-04, full proposal deadline 2027-12-01 at 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: Work Programme Part 8, pp. 143–144, Scope and Specific conditions, funds this work, which connects to Time-dependent transmission rights contract. Annex B permits a Dutch funded consortium member, subject to the China-control restriction. Plant demonstration is central, but the explicit grid-integration outcome provides a credible funded work package alongside a hydropower operator. The funded consortium role supports Type 1 and C1.3. The helper supplied both project dates from 1 January 2027 using its 36-month default.
